title: arctostaphylos glandulosa subsp. zacaensis
intro: Arctostaphylos glandulosa subsp. zacaensis, commonly known as Zaca Manzanita, is a rare and endemic subspecies of the Manzanita plant, specifically found in the Zaca Mountain region of California. As a medicinal herb, Zaca Manzanita has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, alleviate cold and flu symptoms, and aid in the treatment of bronchitis and asthma due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Zaca Manzanita include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Zaca Manzanita include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
